name: perdiem_rates
description: List a scheme's bundled daily allowance rates with the authority, instrument, source URL and effective date they came from. Filter by country or city. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: "pl" Polish delegation regulation, "uk" HMRC benchmark scale rates, "us" GSA CONUS standard. Omit for every scheme

arguments.name: country
arguments.desc: Country name or ISO code, e.g. Germany or DE. Matched exactly first, then as a substring

arguments.name: city
arguments.desc: City or locality name, for the schemes that publish per-city rates

name: perdiem_calc
description: Calculate the daily travel allowance for one trip: the amount per day and the total in the scheme's currency, with the partial-day fraction and the meal deductions the scheme's own rule applies. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: "pl" Polish delegation regulation, "uk" HMRC benchmark scale rates, "us" GSA CONUS standard

arguments.name: destination
arguments.desc: Country or locality, e.g. "Germany", "Poland", "United Kingdom", "United States"

arguments.name: start
arguments.desc: When the trip began, ISO 8601 WITH a zone: "2026-03-28T22:00:00+01:00", or "2026-03-28T22:00" together with timezone

arguments.name: end
arguments.desc: When it ended, same form as start. It must be after start as an instant

arguments.name: timezone
arguments.desc: IANA id such as "Europe/Warsaw". Required when start or end carries no offset; also the zone the US scheme counts calendar days in

arguments.name: meals_provided
arguments.desc: Per day, in order: the free meals the traveller was given that day, e.g. [["breakfast"],["breakfast","lunch"]]. Each one reduces that day's allowance by the scheme's own percentage or amount

arguments.name: meals_provided_daily
arguments.desc: The same free meals on every day. Ignored for any day that meals_provided already names

arguments.name: lodging_nights
arguments.desc: Nights of accommodation. What this pays depends on the scheme and the answer says so

arguments.name: late_evening
arguments.desc: UK only, per day: the journey was ongoing at 8pm and a meal was bought after it, which adds the 10.00 GBP supplement

arguments.name: fiscal_year
arguments.desc: US only, e.g. "FY2025". Defaults to the current bundled fiscal year

name: trip_record
description: Calculate a trip and save it under a name, with the traveller taken from the shared business profile. Returns the TRIP-YYYY-NNNN id. Free tier: 5 trips a calendar month.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: What to call it, e.g. "Berlin client workshop"

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: "pl" Polish delegation regulation, "uk" HMRC benchmark scale rates, "us" GSA CONUS standard

arguments.name: destination
arguments.desc: Country or locality, e.g. "Germany", "Poland", "United Kingdom", "United States"

arguments.name: start
arguments.desc: When the trip began, ISO 8601 WITH a zone: "2026-03-28T22:00:00+01:00", or "2026-03-28T22:00" together with timezone

arguments.name: end
arguments.desc: When it ended, same form as start. It must be after start as an instant

arguments.name: timezone
arguments.desc: IANA id such as "Europe/Warsaw". Required when start or end carries no offset; also the zone the US scheme counts calendar days in

arguments.name: meals_provided
arguments.desc: Per day, in order: the free meals the traveller was given that day, e.g. [["breakfast"],["breakfast","lunch"]]. Each one reduces that day's allowance by the scheme's own percentage or amount

arguments.name: meals_provided_daily
arguments.desc: The same free meals on every day. Ignored for any day that meals_provided already names

arguments.name: lodging_nights
arguments.desc: Nights of accommodation. What this pays depends on the scheme and the answer says so

arguments.name: late_evening
arguments.desc: UK only, per day: the journey was ongoing at 8pm and a meal was bought after it, which adds the 10.00 GBP supplement

arguments.name: fiscal_year
arguments.desc: US only, e.g. "FY2025". Defaults to the current bundled fiscal year

arguments.name: traveller
arguments.desc: Who travelled. Defaults to the shared business profile's name

arguments.name: purpose
arguments.desc: Why the trip happened; kept on the record and carried onto the expense payload

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Project or client this belongs to; carried onto the expense payload

name: trip_list
description: List saved trips with the scheme, destination, dates and total on each, and a total per currency. Filter by scheme, destination, traveller, project and start date range. Free and unlimited.

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: Default "all"

arguments.name: destination
arguments.desc: Only trips to a destination containing this text

arguments.name: traveller
arguments.desc: Only trips by this traveller

arguments.name: project
arguments.desc: Only trips on this project

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, earliest start date

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM-DD, latest start date

name: trip_export
description: Return the exact expense_add arguments for a saved trip, one payload per currency, ready to pass to the expense-tracker server. It writes nothing itself: see the note in the answer. Pro.

arguments.name: trip
arguments.desc: Trip id such as TRIP-2026-0001, or an exact or partial trip name

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Expense category to put on the payload. Default "travel"

arguments.name: billable
arguments.desc: Rebillable to the client. Default: true when the trip has a project, false otherwise

arguments.name: split_lodging
arguments.desc: Return lodging as its own expense rather than folded into the subsistence total. Default true

arguments.name: mark_exported
arguments.desc: Stamp exported_at on the trip so a later export can see it already went out. Default false

name: perdiem_report
description: Total the saved trips per scheme and per calendar month, in each scheme's own currency, with the day count and the trips behind every figure. Pro.

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM, earliest month by start date

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: YYYY-MM, latest month by start date

arguments.name: scheme
arguments.desc: Default "all"

arguments.name: traveller
arguments.desc: Only this traveller

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
